# E11 — Docs and ADR hygiene: implementation-ready spec (basis: `origin/main` = `083620b08116`)

## Decisions fixed by this research (deviations from the brief flagged with ⚠)

| Item | Decision | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Consolidated ADR number | **0119** (`docs/adr/0119-reconciler-architecture-consolidated-record.md`) | 116 ADRs / 116 markers on origin/main (highest `0116`); CLI epic claims 0117, MCP epic 0118. Slug classifies to "Reconciler & Jira sync" (`scripts/gen_adr_index.py:33-88`, verified with `_classify`). |
| `docs/code-review-fp-ledger.md` | ⚠ **KEEP** (not a dated evidence record) | Undated process contract: documents the `fp:code-review` tag, required body fields and the `root-cause:` enum that `src/rebar/llm/code_review/fp_ledger.py:5` names as its documentation. No ticket cites it; deleting it orphans the ledger contract. |
| ADR 0029 banner | ⚠ **Not superseded** by 0092/0094/0103/0107 — banner is "context landed; decisions stand" | `0103-…md:69-72` and `0107-…md:292-295` both state 0029's arbitration is consumed **unchanged**; 0092/0094 never cite it. Its "redesign" (epic `3006-e198-13db-4e1f` file-lens-jewel, child `444d-c21f-2c82-4622` port-jar-withe) is closed and the guardrail is live at `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/inbound_differ.py:214-219` ("ADR 0029 #2"). |
| Phantom `docs/designs/sync-hardening-proposal.md` | Never existed in git history (`git log --all -- 'docs/designs/*'` empty). Replacement: **Item 3** → `_field_contract.py` (exists) + story `a130-2b7c-429c-43d1`; **Item 4b** → ADR 0028 + bug `13eb-c414-0763-4fa1` (false-topaz-prong). In `check_comment_hygiene.py`/its test the path is only a *fixture* of a hyphen-triple filename → replace with the real `docs/plan-review-gate.md`. | `scripts/check_comment_hygiene.py:90`, `tests/unit/test_comment_hygiene_guard.py:166-178` |
| Evidence-record targets | `remediation-implementation-plan.md` + `oss-comparison-and-remediation.md` → epic **hoary-datum-cop** `0b32-bc94-5ea1-482a` (P1.0, root of the `oss-remediation` set; `docs/archive/2026-06-13-oss-comparison-session-log.md:84-92`); `88ab-feature-branch-evidence.md` → epic **elfish-chair-lug** `88ab-7052-8850-46d4`; `dco-rollout-evidence.md` → story **sepia-cardiac-hawk** `ddcd-fc9e-a81f-4cbb` (named in the doc); `serena-symbol-reference-coaching-sample.md` → story **surprised-overjoyful-earthworm** `84c7-ad6c-be99-4c30` (named in the doc). All closed; `rebar comment` has no status check (`src/rebar/_commands/leaf.py:49-75`); none is bridge-bound; all five pass the write-time secret screen (0 findings); largest existing comment is 127 KB so the 52 KB plan fits. |
| Owned elsewhere (say so) | ADR 0071 → editor epic; 0086 (incl. `docs/adr/0086…:67`) → overlap epic; 0044/0049 → HMAC epic; `docs/config.md` tombstone list → config epic; `docs/experiments/`, `docs/calibration/`, `docs/README.md:130,142` → eval-harness epic; `inbound_differ.py:266` + `apply_handlers.py:505` → reconciler epic (exact edits in §Cross-epic). 0042/0090 already carry the banner (`0042…md:3`, `0090…md:5`). | |

Banner format to mirror (quote, `docs/adr/0042-auto-lander.md:3`):
`> **Superseded by [ADR 0047](0047-retire-autolander-rebase-if-necessary.md) (2026-07-13).** Kept for historical context; the decision below no longer reflects how changes land.`
Placement: after the `# ADR` title (and after any existing `> **Renumbered/Number note**` blockquote), before the `**Status:**` line.

---

## Cross-epic assignments (exact edits for the reconciler epic)

- `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/inbound_differ.py:265-266` — replace `# Canonical entries (as of 183fd51ac2; pending consolidation into` / `# _field_contract.py per docs/designs/sync-hardening-proposal.md Item 3):` with `# Canonical entries (as of 183fd51ac2; the per-field symmetry rules live in` / `# _field_contract.py, which names this map; consolidation tracked by story a130-2b7c-429c-43d1):`.
- `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/apply_handlers.py:504-505` — replace `evidence feeds the binding-GC design in` / `# docs/designs/sync-hardening-proposal.md Item 4b.` with `evidence feeds binding retirement per ADR 0028 (deletion is proven only by a` / `# direct 404; bug 13eb-c414-0763-4fa1 covers GC of bindings to deleted issues).`
Both blocks stay accepted by `check_comment_hygiene.py` (grouped-hex ids present). Eval-harness epic owns `docs/experiments/`, `docs/calibration/`, `docs/README.md:130,142`.

## Test-pinned docs (item 9) — what stays green and why

| File edited | Test(s) | Asserts |
|---|---|---|
| `docs/README.md` | `tests/unit/test_check_docs_index.py::test_current_repo_index_is_clean` | every `docs/*.md` is linked from the index; every relative link across the maintained trees resolves |
| `docs/oss-comparison-and-remediation.md` | `tests/interfaces/contracts/test_docs_enumeration_parity.py` (`:103-129,163-170`) | piped type/status spans and "six relations" count match `rebar.types` — arms deleted in S1 |
| `docs/serena-symbol-reference-coaching-sample.md` | `tests/unit/test_project_symbol_reference_completeness.py:208-215` | file exists and names the criterion — test deleted in S1 |
| `docs/adr/0095`, `0103` | `test_wiki_render.py:329-347`, `test_apply_handlers_operation_outcome.py:367-378` | headings/pins and "s3/cutover/fuse/retire" present — bodies preserved in S3 |
| `docs/adr/0111` (not edited) | `tests/scripts/test_internal_shim_policy_docs.py:34-70` | critique names "ADR 0092" + "public/operator" + "compatibility-contract exception" |
| `docs/adr/*` generally | `tests/interfaces/contracts/test_bridge_vocabulary_stale_heldout.py:22`, `scripts/check_adr_numbers.py`, `scripts/gen_adr_index.py --check`, `scripts/check_criteria_vocabulary.py`, `scripts/check_dco_identity.py` | old spellings tolerated only under `docs/adr/`; bijection/index; no "success criteria"; no bot e-mail |
| `docs/plan-review-gate.md` | `test_plan_review_docs.py` (five `###` headings), `test_plan_review.py:894-900` (move table = `MOVE_REGISTRY`), `test_s4_prompt_cutover_edge.py:30-32`, `test_project_portability_docs.py:39-55`, `test_det_floor_clarity.py:200-203`, `test_llm_model_env_removal.py:115-150` | none touch lines 113/122/1158/1183 |
| `docs/ticket-model.md` | `test_gen_ticket_model_taxonomy.py:46-53` (generated taxonomy block), `test_unlink_documentation_contract_b6e1.py:77` (`unlink <source> <target>` present) | untouched by the `:288` rewrite |
| `docs/migrations.md` | `tests/unit/test_init_ensures_seam.py:10-14` (docstring only) | units reachable as `init._<name>` — the S5 wording preserves that claim |
| `infra/runbooks/review-bot-ops.md` | `test_llm_model_env_removal.py:131` | any `REBAR_LLM_MODEL` mention needs removal context in the paragraph/file |
| `scripts/check_comment_hygiene.py`, `tests/unit/test_comment_hygiene_guard.py` | `test_a_hyphenated_file_path_is_not_an_alias_acceptor` (`:166-178`) | a `path/word-triple.md` in a block does not accept a raw SHA — holds for `docs/plan-review-gate.md` |

Ordering: S1 and S2 in parallel → S3 → S4; S5 anytime after S1 (no shared files). No process was left running.
